title.narrative: Activity under preparation Coastal Resilience in Mauritius

description.narrative: To address coastal erosion in Mauritius, a top climate-adaptation priority for the country, the Agence Française de Développement (AFD) Group has financed a comprehensive study on coastal risks in the context of climate change and will support the preparation of a National Shoreline Management Strategy and Roadmap. Through a holistic Team Europe approach, this Action will provide catalytic technical assistance to implement this Roadmap for at least the first three years, complementing AFD/Expertise France¿s support to strategy design and potential support of European Investment Bank (EIB) and AFD for investments. The Action will strengthen Mauritius¿ capacities to manage coastal risks sustainably and inclusively, by : strengthening the legal and governance framework ; improving institutional coordination and multi¿stakeholder dialogue; enhancing knowledge and capacities for science¿based and inclusive decision¿making; preparing pilot interventions on priority coastal sites, with a focus on nature¿based solutions); developing financing mechanisms to mobilise national and international public and private resources, including EIB and AFD loans. The Action is expected to enhance coastal resilience and establish a sustainable shoreline management framework in Mauritius, thereby contributing to the country¿s sustainable development and adaptation to climate change. It supports the country's policies that are aligned with the relevant Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) and the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC). The Action be implemented through indirect management. Expertise France, identified as the implementing partner, will work closely with AFD and the EIB as part of the Team Europe approach.
